verdict.first_step_1: Inventory all JWT call sites, token lifetimes, and verifying processes using grep before generating a new key and deploying dual-key verification.
verdict.first_step_2: Generate a new 32-byte secret via Node crypto and store it in a secret manager without installing it.
verdict.reason: Reply 1 safely pre-deploys the new verification key to all instances before flipping the signing key and uses kid for observable rotation, whereas Reply 2 deploys code without the new secret and switches signing keys simultaneously, which breaks rolling deployments.
